# unbound_local_data (Resource)

Configured local-data ressource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unbound_local_data" "tofu_example_eu" {
  domain = "tofu.example.eu."
  type   = "A"
  value  = "3.5.45.126"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain of the entry
- `type` (String) Type of the entry
- `value` (String) Value of the entry

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) TTL of the entry. Defaults to the Unbound server parameter

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the entry
- `last_updated` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNS entries can be imported by specifying the ID (# at the end of the config line)
terraform import unbound_local_data.tofu_example_eu "3"
```
